Objective: Implement a Dynamic Narrative Engine that transforms historical data, AI civilization behavior, and player actions into emergent quests, lore, and evolving world stories (A2 + A3 + A5 synthesis).

Core Principle.Definition: Narratives are NOT scripted. They are generated from real events stored in the system.
Core Principle.Result: Every quest, myth, and story is historically grounded and unique to the world state.

Effects: Players receive quests based on real events
Lore reflects actual player + AI history

Resulting System.Before: Systems act but do not communicate meaning
